build.signing: Existing OCU Developer ID, hardened runtime

condition: LG and built-in physical screens; same helper binary as built-in-only run.
scope: Thirty actual create/remove cycles, ten groups of three with passive checkpoints; fixed warm slot 28, 1920x1080, 1x. No capture/input.
limitations: Sequential physical-connection conditions, not randomized. Dock/panel/link/topology not separately isolated.
The first post-30 window includes elevated short-term work (89.64% / 13.451 XPC/s); later three passive windows settle around 78.2% / 12.1, still far above baseline.
Other system workloads and intermediate topology between boundary samples not fully controlled.
Exact system caller/internal defect not identified; ICC comparisons cover matched OCU files only.
